description: Sanitizer policy shared by the DMA adapter layer (redact before outbox) and the KW entry re-check (detect only, never rewrite). Patterns are applied to the full logical message before chunking so a secret cannot be split across parts. Replacements carry a non-secret kind label only; the secret value is never logged, stored or returned. A withheld rule means the whole message must not enter the evidence store.
known_secrets_note: Installations may add exact known secrets at runtime (keychain/existing auth references). They are replaced with [REDACTED:KNOWN_SECRET] and never persisted in this policy file.

rules.description: Common API key prefixes (sk-, rk-, pk-) with a long token body.

Multi-line private key block. Withheld: partial redaction cannot guarantee the key is unusable.
Credentials embedded in a URL authority.
Token-like query parameter values in URLs.
